corrections.why: The register, Fire Lookout and TrailChick all say the tower was last used in the 1970s and is now abandoned, with its upper stairs removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Fire Lookout and TrailChick give 1959 for the present tower. The Washington lookouts history site says final completion was in 1960, so 1959 stays as the built year and the story notes the later completion.

sources.title: Sullivan Mountain Lookout | National Historic Lookout Register

notes_for_editor: Status corrected from standing to abandoned (last used 1970s; upper stairs removed), proposed for human review; facts.status set to match. Height disagrees: 20 ft in the register and Fire Lookout; 22 ft on the Washington lookouts site; TrailChick gives 20 ft in its history text and 22 ft in its data box, so height_m is left unset. The lookouts history site also quotes a 1933 newspaper item about a named individual's illness while stationed here; deliberately left out. Laurence Davies is named only as known 1959 personnel from Fire Lookout. The last-used date is given only as the 1970s, so no exact staffed_last year was entered. Access is marked restricted based on the gated road and removed stairs. Coordinates and 1959 build year match the record; elevation 1976 m matches the register's 1,976 m.
